ruleDefinitions.name: Clear PowerShell History - PowerShell Module
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects keywords that could indicate clearing PowerShell history Note: Unmapped fields: Payload

sequences.query: ((Payload = RGX(".*Set\\-PSReadlineOption.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*–HistorySaveStyle.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*SaveNothing.*")) OR (Payload = RGX(".*Set\\-PSReadlineOption.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*\\-HistorySaveStyle.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*SaveNothing.*"))) OR ((Payload = RGX(".*del.*") OR Payload = RGX(".*Remove\\-Item.*") OR Payload = RGX(".*rm.*")) AND Payload = RGX(".*\\(Get\\-PSReadlineOption\\)\\\.HistorySavePath.*"))
